scope: Current lineage of all 45 public requirement groups after outcome separation. Source review and focused evidence are separately cited; this is not a complete hosted run.

requirements.requirement: Public browse/order without accounts or payment form
Eight real supplied prints, images and thirteen variant facts
Grid regular minimum over every offered size, stock state
Mixed availability and sold-out offered editions stay visible
Case-insensitive title search with reset
Size filter includes sold-out editions
Paper filter includes sold-out editions
Regular-grid-price ordering in both directions
Alphabetical title order in both directions
Larger matching photograph and offered paper/stock/trade detail
Per-variant threshold applies trade price to every sheet
Different sizes and different prints do not pool for a tier
Repeated additions combine; dropping below threshold reverses saving
Trade offer visible before qualifying, saving afterward
Gross subtotal, saving, postage and payable remain separate
Inclusive weight bands and over-limit collection
Basket survives reload without another visitor inheriting it
Zero removes line and stays absent after reload
Excess basket quantity refused, availability shown, prior valid quantity retained
Name/address/city/postcode required and server-enforced atomically
Address and amounts visible before commitment
New order reference and lookup without original browser basket
Unknown reference never substitutes another receipt
Unplaced basket reserves no stock; stale multiline atomic refusal
Simultaneous customers cannot buy same last copy
Exact remaining stock can be bought; fresh oversell refused
Invalid quantities/variant make whole order invalid
Duplicate variants aggregate before stock and trade checks
Client monetary claims cannot choose stored charges
Same completed attempt returns its original receipt without another deduction
Reusing attempt with changed quantity or address is refused
A deliberate new purchase of the same basket gets a new reference
Receipt preserves original quantities/address/regular and charged prices
New order placed; cancel once restores exact stock and preserves receipt
Cancelled status terminal even on original-checkout replay
Dispatched historical order cannot be cancelled or restore stock
Restart keeps attempts/orders/statuses/stock without reseeding
Comfortable phone access
Comfortable keyboard browsing
Working light/dark themes
Understandable action feedback and navigation
Readable coherent typography/layout/hierarchy/craft
Local server data, React/Node/Express/SQLite runtime
Start path, port, health, DB_PATH, copied seed/assets
Public assets/CDNs allowed, external backend prohibited

application_health_and_server_data.name: application_health_and_server_data
application_health_and_server_data.description:
Use the browser to open the stated health URL, http://localhost:3000/api/health, and confirm a successful HTTP response. Do not require a particular JSON object, property name, or response body.

Observe network requests during the normal catalogue/detail load and purchase/lookup below. External fonts, scripts, images and CDN assets are allowed and must not fail this gate. The product's orders and stock must come from its supplied local server, without an external backend or data service. Embedded data/blob assets and local loopback addresses are valid; do not demand identical URL origins, hostnames, ports or a particular asset scheme. Browser-internal traffic is not an application dependency. Do not inspect source or fetch bundles to infer this; use actual browser requests.

Browse the populated shop, add one Kiln A3 to a fresh basket, and place an ordinary order with a complete delivery address and a newly chosen recipient name. Use the actual UI and record the resulting order reference and line. Observe the request that submitted this purchase and its server response. Discover methods, routes and payloads from actual browser traffic; do not require a particular route, field name or response schema. A health response, static catalogue response, optimistic success message or seeded receipt alone is insufficient.

Open a separate browser context with no copied cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or service-worker state. Using only the reference just observed, look up that new order through the app's normal order-lookup screen. Observe the server-supplied order response and confirm that the rendered receipt contains the new reference, chosen recipient and Kiln A3 line. Reload this fresh context and confirm the same receipt remains retrievable. A new tab in the original context is not an independent session. Do not seed client storage or substitute an old historical reference. This proves a real shared write/read; it does not identify SQLite or a framework.

Leave this single order placed. It consumes one Kiln A3, normally leaving six for later dimensions. Do not cancel it or place extra orders. Only this basic purchase and independent retrieval are prerequisites: exact price arithmetic, stock enforcement, retry rules, cancellation, process-restart durability, styling and completeness belong to scored dimensions. After two failed attempts at the same action, report the observed failure; never treat an unavailable purchase or lookup as a successful negative test.

populated_public_shop_loads.name: populated_public_shop_loads
populated_public_shop_loads.description: Open http://localhost:3000 without signing in. Confirm a populated shop with identifiable prints and usable navigation renders, rather than a blank page, generic server error, or placeholder shell. Open a print using the shop's own control and confirm its content is reachable. Judge basic access only: exact catalogue counts, complete variant details, price arithmetic, purchasing, and visual quality belong to the scored dimensions.

ridgeline_catalogue_cards_and_variant_de.name: ridgeline_catalogue_cards_and_variant_details
ridgeline_catalogue_cards_and_variant_de.description:
On the grid, confirm eight distinct seeded prints, each with its lowest regular offered price and stock state visible without opening the card. Allotment is sold out; Harbour Mouth, Kiln and Long Field are available. Inspect the offered variants across the eight details: there are thirteen exact SKU-size combinations with the supplied papers, regular prices and trade offers. Their displayed available quantities agree with the current catalogue, including zero for sold-out sizes. Kiln normally starts this dimension at six because the constraints gate bought one; do not demand the untouched seed quantity. Each detail shows its own supplied photograph larger than on the grid. Do not test search, filters, sorting or basket writes in this criterion.

Expected variant facts below use pence; equivalent GBP display is valid. Paper A is Colorplan Pristine White 270gsm, B is Munken Pure Rough 240gsm, C is Colorplan Bright White 270gsm. Columns are SKU/title, size, paper, regular price, available after the gate, trade quantity, trade unit price.
RP-101 Long Field | A3 | A | 3795 | 12 | 3 | 3415
RP-101 Long Field | A2 | A | 5650 | 5 | 3 | 5075
RP-102 Harbour Mouth | A3 | B | 3795 | 9 | 3 | 3415
RP-102 Harbour Mouth | A2 | B | 5650 | 0 | 3 | 5075
RP-103 Nine Windows | A3 | A | 4250 | 20 | 5 | 3625
RP-104 Slack Water | A3 | B | 3795 | 2 | 3 | 3415
RP-104 Slack Water | A2 | B | 5650 | 1 | 3 | 5075
RP-105 Kiln | A3 | C | 3795 | 6 | 3 | 3415
RP-106 Two Weathers | A3 | B | 4250 | 14 | 5 | 3625
RP-106 Two Weathers | A2 | B | 6450 | 3 | 5 | 5595
RP-107 Allotment | A3 | A | 3795 | 0 | 3 | 3415
RP-108 Night Ferry | A3 | C | 4250 | 6 | 5 | 3625
RP-108 Night Ferry | A2 | C | 6450 | 4 | 5 | 5595

ridgeline_catalogue_title_search.name: ridgeline_catalogue_title_search
ridgeline_catalogue_title_search.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Use the title-search control to enter "hArBoUr": only Harbour Mouth remains. Clear the search and confirm all eight prints return. Judge this case-insensitive search and its clearing only; do not make passing a size filter, paper filter, sort or detail check a prerequisite. No particular control layout is required.

ridgeline_catalogue_size_filter.name: ridgeline_catalogue_size_filter
ridgeline_catalogue_size_filter.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select the A2 size filter. Exactly Harbour Mouth, Long Field, Night Ferry, Slack Water and Two Weathers remain, including Harbour Mouth's sold-out A2; Kiln, Nine Windows and Allotment are absent. Clear this size filter and confirm all eight prints return. Judge size membership and clearing only; search, paper filtering, sorting and detail content are separate outcomes. No particular control layout is required.

ridgeline_catalogue_paper_filter.name: ridgeline_catalogue_paper_filter
ridgeline_catalogue_paper_filter.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select the Munken Pure Rough 240gsm stock-sheet filter. Exactly Harbour Mouth, Slack Water and Two Weathers remain. Clear this paper filter and confirm all eight prints return. Then select only Colorplan Pristine White 270gsm: exactly Allotment, Long Field and Nine Windows remain, including fully sold-out Allotment. Clear that filter and confirm all eight prints return again. Judge stock-sheet membership, inclusion of sold-out editions and clearing only; search, size filtering, sorting and detail content are separate outcomes. No particular control layout is required.

ridgeline_catalogue_regular_price_orderi.name: ridgeline_catalogue_regular_price_ordering
ridgeline_catalogue_regular_price_orderi.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select price ascending: the five GBP 37.95-from prints (Allotment, Harbour Mouth, Kiln, Long Field and Slack Water) precede the three GBP 42.50-from prints (Night Ferry, Nine Windows and Two Weathers). Select price descending: those groups reverse. Equal-price ties can use any order. Exercise the actual price-ordering control and compare the whole collection in both directions. Judge price order only, without requiring alphabetical ordering, filter behavior or regrading detail content.

ridgeline_catalogue_alphabetical_title_o.name: ridgeline_catalogue_alphabetical_title_ordering
ridgeline_catalogue_alphabetical_title_o.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select title ascending: the order is Allotment, Harbour Mouth, Kiln, Long Field, Night Ferry, Nine Windows, Slack Water, Two Weathers. Select title descending: the order is exactly the reverse. Exercise the actual title-ordering control and compare the whole collection in both directions. Judge alphabetical title order only, without requiring price ordering, filter behavior or regrading detail content.

ridgeline_sold_out_variants_not_addable.name: ridgeline_sold_out_variants_not_addable
ridgeline_sold_out_variants_not_addable.description: R07: Observe an available Harbour A3 added successfully and the offered sold-out Harbour A2 and Allotment remaining visible but unavailable for addition. Do not grade excess quantities here. Execute the shared R07 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_overstock_basket_keeps_last_va.name: ridgeline_overstock_basket_keeps_last_valid_line
ridgeline_overstock_basket_keeps_last_va.description: R07: Observe the successful one-unit Slack A2 basket, then the two-unit attempt refused with availability exposed and the last valid quantity retained. Do not inherit the separate sold-out-variant result. Execute the shared R07 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_unplaced_basket_survives_full_.name: ridgeline_unplaced_basket_survives_full_reload
ridgeline_unplaced_basket_survives_full_.description: R08: Observe the two Night Ferry A2 lines/quantities and exact basket figures after a full reload. Visitor isolation is separate; inability to open an evaluator context is not a product reload failure. Execute the shared R08 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_visitors_keep_independent_bask.name: ridgeline_visitors_keep_independent_baskets
ridgeline_visitors_keep_independent_bask.description: R08: Observe initially clean context B, its own Long Field basket, and both contexts retaining their distinct contents after reload. Use the continuing original page and the supplied second-context recipe. Do not inherit pricing or reload criterion verdicts. Execute the shared R08 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_zero_quantity_removal_stays_em.name: ridgeline_zero_quantity_removal_stays_empty
ridgeline_zero_quantity_removal_stays_em.description: Establish this criterion's own positive control: clear the basket, add one available Night Ferry A2 through the UI, and confirm its line is present with quantity one. Set that line's quantity to zero using the basket's quantity control. The line disappears and no postage or payable amount remains. Perform a genuine full-page reload and confirm it stays empty. A permanently empty or broken basket cannot pass; the successful addition must have been observed here. Do not place an order or rely on the previous reload criterion succeeding.

trade_threshold_reversal_and_size_isolat.name: trade_threshold_reversal_and_size_isolation
trade_threshold_reversal_and_size_isolat.description:
1. Empty the basket. Add four Night Ferry A3 and one Night Ferry A2. Their combined quantity is five, but neither exact variant reaches its own five-unit trade break. A3 stays GBP 42.50, A2 stays GBP 64.50, gross subtotal is GBP 234.50, saving zero, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 239.45. The detail view explains the trade offer before it applies.
2. Increase only A3 to five: A3 is now GBP 36.25 each, A3 line total GBP 181.25, while A2 remains GBP 64.50. Gross subtotal is GBP 277.00, saving GBP 31.25, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 250.70. The applied trade price is clear in the product/basket view.
3. Reduce A3 back to four. Both regular prices and the exact figures in leg 1 return. Empty the basket. No checkout is performed.

postage_inclusive_boundaries_and_collect.name: postage_inclusive_boundaries_and_collection
postage_inclusive_boundaries_and_collect.description:
Use the derived weights below to select the expected postage. The app must show the charge and any collection-only status; it need not display grams or a postage-band name.
1. Empty the basket. One Nine Windows A3 weighs 90 g and costs GBP 1.75 postage.
2. Replace it with two Nine Windows A3 and two Long Field A2: 500 g exactly must cost GBP 3.20, not GBP 4.95.
3. Replace that basket with eight Nine Windows A3, four Long Field A2 and four Night Ferry A2. This is exactly 2,000 g and costs GBP 4.95 postage. All quantities fit the untouched starting stock.
4. Increase Nine Windows A3 to nine: the 2,090 g basket becomes collection-only, with zero postage, and clearly says it cannot be delivered. Empty the basket. These are preview checks; do not place any orders.

historical_receipt_uses_charged_prices.name: historical_receipt_uses_charged_prices
historical_receipt_uses_charged_prices.description:
1. Use the reference lookup to open RP-100001. It is dispatched and shows two Long Field A3 at GBP 35.00 each, subtotal GBP 70.00, saving zero, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 73.20.
2. Empty the basket. Open today's Long Field A3 at GBP 37.95 and place one through the normal UI with a valid address. Capture its request and reference. A fresh lookup of this new receipt shows GBP 37.95 subtotal, zero saving, GBP 1.75 postage and total GBP 39.70; live stock falls from twelve to eleven.
3. Reload or freshly look up RP-100001, then the new reference. The historical receipt remains dispatched at GBP 35.00 per unit and GBP 73.20 total, while the new one retains its current price and GBP 39.70 total. Neither receipt borrows the other's prices.
Return to the catalogue. Do not cancel either order here; cancellation enforcement is checked with its own positive control later. Unknown-reference handling is scored separately.

ridgeline_unknown_reference_does_not_sub.name: ridgeline_unknown_reference_does_not_substitute_receipt
ridgeline_unknown_reference_does_not_sub.description: Use the actual order-lookup UI to open known reference RP-100001 successfully and confirm the result identifies that reference. Then use the same control with a different well-formed but nonexistent reference, retaining the reference format the app demonstrates. The UI must clearly communicate that it was not found and must not present RP-100001 or another receipt as the result for the unknown reference. Look up RP-100001 again to prove normal lookup still works. Judge lookup discrimination only; do not regrade its historical price arithmetic or require an exact error message/HTTP status. This read-only check has its own successful control and does not depend on a prior new order.

ridgeline_checkout_address_and_amount_re.name: ridgeline_checkout_address_and_amount_review
ridgeline_checkout_address_and_amount_re.description: R14: Before commitment, the UI presents the entered address and all four correct amounts for the specified mixed basket. A single screen is valid. Judge the pre-order review, not later receipt/storage results. Execute the shared R14 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

mixed_trade_prices_survive_order_lookup.name: mixed_trade_prices_survive_order_lookup
mixed_trade_prices_survive_order_lookup.description: R14: After the actual mixed UI purchase, freshly retrieve its own reference and verify exact address, combined lines, variant-specific charged prices and receipt figures, plus the corresponding stock differences. A missing pre-commit summary does not negate a correct stored transaction. Execute the shared R14 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_incomplete_delivery_address_re.name: ridgeline_incomplete_delivery_address_refuses_atomically
ridgeline_incomplete_delivery_address_re.description:
1. Establish an independent valid control. Clear the basket and record current Kiln A3 stock S, normally five after the gate and mixed order. Place one Kiln A3 through the ordinary UI with a complete recipient name, address line, city and postcode. Discover and record the real request method, path, headers, body and attempt-identity mechanism. Fresh lookup shows the entered address, one unit and GBP 39.70 total (GBP 37.95 plus GBP 1.75 postage); stock is S minus one.
2. From that observed operation, prepare four separate fresh checkout attempts for one Kiln A3, each with a new uncompleted attempt identity, otherwise valid lines and otherwise complete address. In turn omit or leave blank only the recipient name, the address line, the city, then the postcode, following the actual address representation and field roles rather than imposing property names. Do not change the country or other valid app-specific data. These probes must reach the server even if ordinary form validation blocks the UI submission. Do not introduce postal-format, length or outside address-verification checks.
3. Every incomplete attempt must be refused without a successful new reference, a saved incomplete-address order or any stock deduction. After each refusal, reread Kiln stock and the positive-control receipt; stock stays S minus one and that order's address and figures stay unchanged. A disabled form or error status alone does not prove server enforcement. If a bad attempt unexpectedly creates an order or changes stock, fail this criterion and stop further probe orders so later criteria can use the observed remaining stock; never award credit for unperformed legs.
4. After all four refusals, start a separate NEW normal UI checkout with all four address components complete and buy one Kiln A3. It succeeds with its own fresh reference, the entered complete address and GBP 39.70 total. Fresh stock is S minus two, normally three. This follow-up proves valid ordering still works; it must not be a replay of the first order. Keep both valid orders placed and empty the basket. Do not cancel anything here or regrade idempotency.

authoritative_prices_on_fresh_checkout.name: authoritative_prices_on_fresh_checkout
authoritative_prices_on_fresh_checkout.description:
1. Empty the basket and complete a genuine UI order for one Two Weathers A2 with a valid address, recording its actual request. Its correct unit/subtotal is GBP 64.50, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 67.70. Stock falls from three to two.
2. Prepare a separate fresh checkout attempt for one more of the same variant. Using the actual observed request format and a fresh attempt identity, add or change monetary claims to a unit price of one penny, zero shipping and a one-penny total. Do not reuse the completed attempt identity: returning its old receipt would not test pricing.
3. The fresh request may either be rejected without any order or stock change, or succeed at the authoritative GBP 64.50 unit price, GBP 3.20 postage and GBP 67.70 total. Re-read stock and, on success, the new order by reference. Rejection leaves two; successful authoritative repricing leaves one. A false displayed success, a token-priced stored order or any other decrement fails. Re-read the positive-control receipt and confirm it was not altered.

ridgeline_repeated_additions_merge_in_ba.name: ridgeline_repeated_additions_merge_in_basket
ridgeline_repeated_additions_merge_in_ba.description: R17: Repeated UI additions of three and two Nine Windows A3 become one five-unit line with the correct trade price. Observe that UI state itself; server duplicate-entry handling is separate. Execute the shared R17 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_combined_server_lines_receive_.name: ridgeline_combined_server_lines_receive_trade_price
ridgeline_combined_server_lines_receive_.description: R17: The observed list-shaped request containing three plus two of the same variant produces one stored five-unit line with the specified trade figures and stock difference. A keyed representation uses combined five. Require this successful current operation; do not inherit the UI merge verdict. Execute the shared R17 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_combined_overstock_refused.name: ridgeline_combined_overstock_refused
ridgeline_combined_overstock_refused.description: R17: After a real successful order control, the fresh combined overstock attempt is refused without a new order, stock change or receipt mutation. For list-shaped requests, use repeated entries whose sum exceeds observed stock although each entry fits. Successful duplicate pricing is not a prerequisite verdict. Execute the shared R17 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_invalid_checkout_quantities_re.name: ridgeline_invalid_checkout_quantities_refused
ridgeline_invalid_checkout_quantities_re.description: R17: Following a real valid purchase control, each separate fresh zero, negative and fractional quantity request is refused atomically. Observe stock and unchanged control receipt after each. These are the finite invalid quantity classes of one quantity-validation behavior; do not inherit duplicate-line or unknown-variant verdicts. Execute the shared R17 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_unknown_variant_refuses_entire.name: ridgeline_unknown_variant_refuses_entire_order
ridgeline_unknown_variant_refuses_entire.description: R17: With the valid purchase control established, a fresh order containing one available real line and one nonexistent variant is refused as a whole without deducting the real line or changing the control receipt. Do not infer atomicity from an HTTP error alone. Execute the shared R17 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

stale_multiline_checkout_leaves_every_st.name: stale_multiline_checkout_leaves_every_stock_unchanged
stale_multiline_checkout_leaves_every_st.description:
1. Prepare, but do not submit, checkout attempt A for two Harbour Mouth A3 and one Long Field A3 with a valid address. Preserve that attempt's basket/request independently from attempt B. Two browser contexts are one option; retaining A's unsubmitted request before building B in the same browser is equally valid. Separate tabs alone may share browser storage. Record Long Field's current available quantity. A basket is not a reservation.
2. In B place eight Harbour Mouth A3 as a fresh valid order. Its stored gross subtotal is GBP 303.60, saving GBP 30.40, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 278.15; fresh Harbour A3 stock is one. This is the positive control for the real order endpoint.
3. Attempt A's original two-Harbour plus one-Long-Field order. If the UI prevents submission after refreshing stock, also submit that stale multi-line quantity directly using the recorded checkout format and A's fresh, uncompleted attempt identity. Refusal must be enforced by the server.
4. Re-read both variants and B's order. Harbour remains one, Long Field remains exactly the quantity recorded in leg 1, and B's receipt is unchanged. A must have no successful order/reference and neither its valid line nor its stale line may be deducted. An error response alone does not prove atomicity. Clear both baskets without placing anything further.

ridgeline_identical_checkout_returns_ori.name: ridgeline_identical_checkout_returns_original_order
ridgeline_identical_checkout_returns_ori.description: R19: Following the actual first successful Night Ferry A2 purchase, two identical replays return its exact reference and receipt without additional stock deduction. A retry failure does not determine the changed-payload or genuinely new purchase outcomes. Execute the shared R19 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_l.name: ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_lines
ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_l.description: R19: The completed attempt identity with changed quantities is refused, preserving the original receipt and stock. Require the real initial successful order; exact retry success is not required. Execute the shared R19 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_a.name: ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_address
ridgeline_used_attempt_rejects_changed_a.description: R19: The completed attempt identity with original lines but a different valid address is refused, preserving the original address, receipt and stock. Do not inherit the changed-lines verdict. Execute the shared R19 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_new_checkout_can_repeat_same_b.name: ridgeline_new_checkout_can_repeat_same_basket
ridgeline_new_checkout_can_repeat_same_b.description: R19: A deliberately new UI checkout with the original basket and address receives a distinct reference, its own correct receipt and exactly one new stock deduction. It is not a replay. Assess this separately from reused-identity refusal. Execute the shared R19 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_cancel_restores_exact_stock_an.name: ridgeline_cancel_restores_exact_stock_and_keeps_receipt
ridgeline_cancel_restores_exact_stock_an.description: R20: The newly placed Night Ferry A3 order can be cancelled normally: its exact quantities return to stock, status becomes cancelled, and all original charged figures/address remain retrievable. Repeated cancellation and dispatched-order protection are separate. Execute the shared R20 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_repeated_cancel_does_not_resto.name: ridgeline_repeated_cancel_does_not_restore_twice
ridgeline_repeated_cancel_does_not_resto.description: R20: After observing an actual successful cancellation, both cancellation replays leave the same cancelled receipt and stock unchanged. Missing cancellation capability cannot earn absence-based credit. Execute the shared R20 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_checkout_replay_does_not_reviv.name: ridgeline_checkout_replay_does_not_revive_cancelled_order
ridgeline_checkout_replay_does_not_reviv.description: R20: After observing the actual successful cancellation, replaying its original checkout returns that same cancelled reference and receipt without stock deduction or resurrection. Do not inherit repeated-cancel results. Execute the shared R20 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_dispatched_order_cannot_be_can.name: ridgeline_dispatched_order_cannot_be_cancelled
ridgeline_dispatched_order_cannot_be_can.description: R20: With an actual cancellable-order operation as a positive control, attempt the observed cancellation operation for dispatched RP-100001. It refuses and preserves that historical receipt and Long Field A3 stock. Run this independent probe even if a prior replay failed. Execute the shared R20 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

simultaneous_last_copy_commits_only_once.name: simultaneous_last_copy_commits_only_once
simultaneous_last_copy_commits_only_once.description:
1. Empty the basket and place one Slack Water A3 normally, using a fresh attempt identity. Its total is GBP 39.70 (GBP 37.95 plus GBP 1.75 postage), leaving exactly one. Record the successful request as the positive control.
2. Prepare two independent checkout attempts, each for the remaining one Slack Water A3, with different fresh attempt identities. Submit them concurrently from the app's browser page to the observed local application-server URL using its real request shape and origin policy, for example Promise.all around the two requests. These are different buyers, not retries of one request.
3. Exactly one attempt succeeds with a new reference and the GBP 39.70 receipt; the other is refused without an order. Fresh stock is zero, never negative. Look up the successful receipt and the leg 1 receipt: each contains one unit, with distinct references. Do not cancel either. Sequentially clicking two already-refreshed sold-out controls is not this test.

ridgeline_sold_out_cheapest_variant_keep.name: ridgeline_sold_out_cheapest_variant_keeps_grid_price
ridgeline_sold_out_cheapest_variant_keep.description:
1. Read the current Slack Water A3 and A2 quantities from the live catalogue/detail. The earlier concurrency scenario normally leaves A3 at zero and A2 at one, but do not infer that state or inherit its verdict. If A3 still has copies because the earlier scenario did not complete, establish this criterion's own state: clear the basket, use a fresh normal UI checkout to buy exactly the observed remaining A3 quantity with a complete valid address, and then reread both quantities. Do not buy A2, reset the seed, cancel an earlier order or guess stock. If this setup cannot establish A3 at zero with A2 still available, report this criterion's incomplete/failed setup and continue to the next criterion.
2. With that independently observed state, return to the real catalogue grid. Slack Water must still be available because its A2 edition remains available, and its displayed starting regular price must remain GBP 37.95 from the offered A3 edition even though that cheaper edition has sold out. Using only the available A2 price of GBP 56.50 is incorrect. Open its detail to confirm the zero A3 quantity and positive A2 quantity, then reload and return to the grid: the same GBP 37.95 starting price and available state remain. Judge this catalogue outcome only, not the preceding concurrency verdict or the separate last-unit checkout arithmetic. Leave A2 untouched for the next criterion.

last_unit_order_and_fresh_oversell_refus.name: last_unit_order_and_fresh_oversell_refusal
last_unit_order_and_fresh_oversell_refus.description:
1. Empty the basket. Slack Water A2 still has its one untouched starting unit. Buy exactly one through the normal UI. The receipt shows GBP 56.50 unit/subtotal, zero saving, GBP 3.20 postage and GBP 59.70 total, with the entered address and a reference. Reload the confirmation or look it up fresh and confirm those values. Fresh stock is zero.
2. Using this observed request shape but a fresh checkout attempt identity, submit one more of the same variant. It must refuse without a new order or any stock change. Re-read the successful receipt and stock. Replaying the original identity would test retry handling instead and cannot satisfy this leg.

successive_orders_use_remaining_stock_an.name: successive_orders_use_remaining_stock_and_own_tiers
successive_orders_use_remaining_stock_an.description:
1. Empty the basket. Long Field A2 has five available. Place two: stored unit price GBP 56.50, line total/gross GBP 113.00, zero saving, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 116.20. Fresh stock is three.
2. Start a separate checkout for exactly those remaining three. It succeeds at the three-unit trade price GBP 50.75. Reload or look up this second reference: charged line total GBP 152.25, gross GBP 169.50, saving GBP 17.25, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 155.45. Fresh stock is zero.
3. Look up the first reference again. Its two-unit regular price and GBP 116.20 total remain unchanged; the second order's trade break must not retroactively discount it. Both references are distinct and the original addresses remain correct. Do not cancel either order.

ridgeline_order_snapshots_survive_proces.name: ridgeline_order_snapshots_survive_process_restart
ridgeline_order_snapshots_survive_proces.description: R25: After the single actual process restart, each successfully established pre-restart control retains its recorded reference, status, address, lines and charged figures. An unsuccessfully cancelled control may remain placed: compare its actual recorded status. No successful cancellation is required to prove placed-order durability. Execute the shared R25 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_all_stock_and_catalogue_surviv.name: ridgeline_all_stock_and_catalogue_survive_restart
ridgeline_all_stock_and_catalogue_surviv.description: R25: After that actual restart, all thirteen variant quantities equal their complete observed pre-restart snapshot, with eight distinct prints/thirteen offered variants and the unchanged historical receipt. Do not inherit cancellation, new-receipt or replay verdicts. Execute the shared R25 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

ridgeline_attempt_mappings_survive_resta.name: ridgeline_attempt_mappings_survive_restart
ridgeline_attempt_mappings_survive_resta.description: R25: The original successful checkout attempts replay after the actual restart to their own recorded reference/status without stock changes. Replay an actually successful pre-restart cancellation if one exists; its stock effect remains terminal. If cancellation was unavailable, use the two recorded placed controls to test persisted attempt identity without making cancellation a prerequisite. Judge persistence of the observed mappings, not whether cancellation worked before restart. Execute the shared R25 procedure once and assign this outcome from its own observations, without inheriting another outcome's verdict.

responsive_layout.name: responsive_layout
responsive_layout.description: At a roughly 390 by 844 viewport, open the catalogue and basket. Essential text and controls remain reachable and are not obscured by overlapping panels or page-wide overflow. Stacking, scrolling and different mobile navigation are valid; intentionally scrollable content may scroll. No purchase is needed.

labelled_controls_and_focus.name: labelled_controls_and_focus
labelled_controls_and_focus.description: At an ordinary desktop viewport, inspect search, size/paper/sort controls, print-opening and return controls, basket, theme, available size/quantity/add controls, basket quantity/removal and checkout navigation, delivery fields, order submission, and reference lookup. Each purpose has a visible label or accessible name. Use actual keyboard events to reach these controls when enabled and confirm visible focus; native focus styling, menus and composite arrow-key navigation are valid. Pointer setup may prepare one available unplaced unit and open each surface. Do not place or cancel an order just to inspect focus; reaching the enabled submit control is sufficient. Use the known historical receipt to return to the shop without requiring cancellation there. Disabled/sold-out controls need not be focusable. This criterion owns labels, reachability and visible focus; the separate navigation outcome observes opening and leaving views. No exact words, focus order or app-documented native key is required. Leave the unplaced basket empty afterward.

interaction_feedback.name: interaction_feedback
interaction_feedback.description: Use a title search that matches a currently listed print, then clear it; the changed results are apparent. Add one currently available unit to the basket and observe visible feedback such as an updated count, basket contents or a confirmation message. Judge whether the interface acknowledges these ordinary actions; do not regrade prices, stock enforcement or checkout persistence here. Leave that unplaced basket empty afterward.

ridgeline_light_dark_switch_changes_them.name: ridgeline_light_dark_switch_changes_theme
ridgeline_light_dark_switch_changes_them.description: Switch between light and dark themes and confirm the page chrome and controls actually change, rather than only the toggle label. Visual owns contrast, palette and aesthetic readability. Missing keyboard navigation does not determine this verdict.

ridgeline_keyboard_views_have_usable_ret.name: ridgeline_keyboard_views_have_usable_return
ridgeline_keyboard_views_have_usable_ret.description:
At an ordinary desktop viewport, start from the catalogue with cleared filters. If needed, prepare one currently available unit in an unplaced basket through the normal UI; this setup may use a pointer. Now use only keyboard actions to open a print detail, return to the catalogue, open the basket and leave it for the catalogue. Each chosen view actually opens and the previous surface remains usable without a stranded overlay or lost navigation. Pages, drawers, dialogs and native browser controls are valid; accept ordinary or app-documented keys without prescribing a layout or bindings. Do not use pointer actions, programmatic focus, DOM clicks or application API calls during this route.

Judge view changes and usable return navigation here, without repeating the labels/focus verdict. No keyboard-only purchase, price calculation or durable write is required. Leave the unplaced basket empty afterward using ordinary UI actions; pointer cleanup is allowed. Do not place or cancel an order.
Theme switching does not determine this navigation verdict.

visual_typography.name: visual_typography
visual_typography.description:
Assess typography across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: text is comfortably readable, headings and labels are distinguishable, and the type treatment is consistent enough to follow the interface without effort. Harmless small variations do not prevent full credit.
4: generally readable, with a few distracting size, alignment or truncation issues.
3: readable overall but several inconsistent or cramped text treatments slow scanning.
2: substantial portions are difficult to read.
1: typography is largely unreadable or the relevant surface does not render.

visual_color_and_contrast.name: visual_color_and_contrast
visual_color_and_contrast.description:
Assess colour and contrast across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: text has clear contrast, colours work together, and visible states remain easy to distinguish in each offered theme. A restrained or native-looking palette can earn full credit.
4: generally clear, with a few distracting contrast or colour inconsistencies.
3: several low-contrast or conflicting treatments reduce clarity.
2: frequent contrast problems make important content difficult to read.
1: colour treatment is largely unreadable or the relevant surface does not render.

visual_spacing_and_layout.name: visual_spacing_and_layout
visual_spacing_and_layout.description:
Assess spacing and layout across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: groups have clear separation, spacing supports comfortable reading, and essential content is not obscured by overlap or clipping. Simple conventional layouts can earn full credit.
4: mostly orderly, with a few distracting gaps, alignments or crowded areas.
3: several crowded or uneven areas make the layout harder to follow.
2: frequent collisions or clipping obscure important content.
1: the layout is broadly unusable or the relevant surface does not render.

visual_hierarchy_and_scanability.name: visual_hierarchy_and_scanability
visual_hierarchy_and_scanability.description:
Assess visual hierarchy and scannability across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: the main content, current context and primary controls are easy to locate, with sensible grouping and visual emphasis. No particular branding, hero section or layout is required.
4: mostly clear, with a few competing or insufficiently prominent elements.
3: several important labels or controls are visually buried among similar elements.
2: weak grouping and emphasis make the interface difficult to scan.
1: no usable visual hierarchy is apparent or the relevant surface does not render.

visual_overall_craft.name: visual_overall_craft
visual_overall_craft.description:
Assess overall visual consistency across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: the reviewed surfaces form a coherent, readable interface with consistent controls and a reasonably finished appearance. Native components, simple styling and minor harmless imperfections are compatible with full credit.
4: generally coherent, with a few visibly inconsistent or unfinished details.
3: several mismatched or unfinished elements interrupt the presentation.
2: most surfaces appear inconsistent or unfinished.
1: little coherent presentation is apparent or the relevant surfaces do not render.

visual_responsive_consistency.name: visual_responsive_consistency
visual_responsive_consistency.description:
Compare the composition of at least two of the same surfaces at desktop and roughly 390 by 844 mobile size. Judge how their group proportions, density and visual arrangement adapt. Stacking, a simple single column, drawers or intentional scrolling can all earn full credit. Mobile control reachability, operability, clipping and overflow belong to Polish; do not deduct for those same observations here.
5: groups keep a sensible visual relationship as the width changes, with a balanced arrangement and comfortable density at each size. Simple conventional adaptation is sufficient.
4: mostly coherent adaptation, with a few distracting changes in group proportions or density.
3: several awkward changes in relative scale or grouping weaken the composition.
2: the cross-viewport arrangement has little consistent grouping or balance.
1: no coherent relationship between the two compositions is apparent, or the required views do not render.
